title: WriteTestsRequest
description: What the test writer reads to write the slice's tests: the slice's conditions, the interface files' paths, a worktree at the slice's base that holds no builder's work, and the practices; from round 2 on, its own earlier tests and the reviewer's findings for it.

interface.description: The interface files the slice builds against, relative to the slice's worktree.

folder.description: A worktree at the slice's base commit, relative to the project. It holds no builder's work.

practices.description: The practices files to read before writing, relative to the project, from forge's settings.

earlier.description: From round 2 on: the tests it handed in before.

findings.description: From round 2 on: the reviewer's findings for the test writer.

rules.description: The rules of the committed design that the slice's actions apply, each a pure function: its name, what it decides, what it takes and gives, and the actions that apply it. A test may call a rule with values and compare the value it gives. Left out when there is none.

finding.description: One finding of the reviewer, for the test writer or for the builder.

to.description: Who the finding is for: the test writer corrects the tests, the builder the code.

case.description: A case's name, as the tests name it.

question.description: The question the case fails: Q1 to Q10 of reviewing-tests.md, negative-paths, condition, or the id of a practice given.

fix.description: One sentence on what would fix it. For the builder it shares no run of 20 characters with the tests.
